summary: For target encodings requiring numeric character replacement, encode_from_utf8 subtracted NCR_EXTRA (9 at this revision) from the destination length without checking its size. A shorter buffer caused subtraction overflow or a subsequent slice-bounds panic. The fix returns (CoderResult::OutputFull, 0, 0, false) before subtracting. The proposed reversal restores the exact parent implementation. Blocked: no detecting upstream test was found at the fixed commit. The fix adds no tests; existing encoding test helpers allocate at least 10 output bytes, and Encoding::encode reserves replacement space.
